_about: One row per runtime-layer format: where its files are found, the order they apply in, who wins a conflict and how a line is split. The server reads these values and the generator's skill-text mode, run by hand, prints the skill paragraphs from them (docs/architecture/runtime-formats.md). Each block's 'source' names the upstream text it is taken from; 'reading' marks a rule upstream does not state.

switches.source: Nexus 6085; LIGH 12456 (Light runs without its key)

order.source: Nexus 6085 (patcher order, breadth-first); ARR 7.0.x SkyPatcher.log (same order)

passes.name: Race Hook
passes.note: runs earlier, while the races load

targets.source: Nexus 6085; the address character is this row's grammar.address, spelt once there

_distributors_about: The four distributor formats: discovery and target spelling, and a 'lines' block (line kinds, order, conflict and grammar) on each row whose reader has landed; SPID's and KID's have, the others' land with their own readers. 'unread' is a rule this build has not read for that format, never a claim about it.
